newsitem.title: UK: Brent crude cargoes - two kept, one clocked.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude cargoes - two kept, one clocked.

text.p: Two of the Brent crude oil cargoes which turned wet on Monday were kept by trader Arcadia and U.S. refiner Koch was five o' clocked with the third.
The three cargoes are scheduled to load in the March 25-27 loading window.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
